description: Scrape Chrome Web Store extensions by URL, category, search query, or top-charts.

categoryUrls.description: Chrome Web Store category page URLs. Used when mode=`category`.
categoryUrls.title: Category URLs

developerNameContains.description: Only emit extensions whose developer name contains this substring (case-insensitive).
developerNameContains.title: Developer name contains

extensionUrls.description: Direct Chrome Web Store extension URLs (or just IDs). Used when mode=`urls`.
extensionUrls.title: Extension URLs

maxItems.description: Maximum number of extensions to emit.
maxItems.title: Max items

minInstalls.description: Drop extensions with fewer than this many installs.
minInstalls.title: Min installs (filter)

minRating.description: Drop extensions with average rating below this (0.0–5.0). E.g. 4.5
minRating.title: Min rating (filter)

mode.description: How to discover extensions. `urls` = direct lookup, `category` = walk a category page, `search` = search query, `topCharts` = popular extensions.
mode.title: Mode

searchQuery.description: Free-text search term. Used when mode=`search`.
searchQuery.title: Search query

topChartsCategory.description: Chrome Web Store category slug (`<parent>/<child>` form). Used when mode=`topCharts`. Leave empty for the global top extensions list.
topChartsCategory.title: Top charts category

verifiedOnly.description: Only emit extensions whose developer has the verified badge.
verifiedOnly.title: Verified developers only

title: Chrome Extensions Scraper Pro Input
